compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Incident Overview
Source: code review (passed) — minor finding not addressed in this session.
Finding: The comment on the call_count==2 branch says 'triggers soft cap nudge' but that call corresponds to aug_turn=0 (a normal augmentation turn). The comment on the else branch says 'After nudge: emits BOTH...' but this fires at aug_turn=1 (before any nudge). The test outcome is valid but mock comments misrepresent when the nudge boundary occurs.
File: tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_context_augmentation.py
Category: hygiene

comments.body: Fixed: corrected misleading comments in test_augmentation_post_nudge_request_with_findings_is_ignored. call_count==2 branch comment now correctly says aug_turn=0 normal turn with soft_cap=2 not yet reached (not 'triggers soft cap nudge'). else branch comment now explains that call 3+ fires at both aug_turn=1 normal turn and after nudge at aug_turn=2, with the post-nudge check (nudge_count>=1 and has_findings) breaking the loop.
